moments.action: A barcode fills a projection screen; the frame widens to a girl in school uniform presenting it on a dark auditorium stage. The slide then tags two bars 'A' and 'B', and the seated students watch, grinning.
Pat takes the spotlight in front of a slide of a giant 2B pencil carrying the same barcode, turning a real pencil in his fingers; the cut then drops him entirely and leaves only the pencil on screen.

Cutaways out of the hall: Lynn reads an exam booklet aloud among printing presses, a laughing boy and girl plant coloured flag pins across a map beside an STIC box, then Lynn turns away from the booklet.
Back on stage Pat speaks in half-light; a wide shows the uniformed girl at the lectern under the pencil slide, then Pat swings round to the crowd mid-shout, the pitch turning into a performance.
Pat works the edge of the blank screen with his shadow thrown huge across it, arms open to the room, then the camera tightens to a dark profile as he lowers the pencil and quiets down.
Cut away to a laundry: Bank, framed through a doorway with an armful of white sheets, stops and looks off to one side, alone and nowhere near the auditorium.
The hall erupts: students shoot up from their chairs clapping and whooping. A boy stands arms-folded in the spotlight, then breaks into a mock dance as the cheering spills across the rows behind him.
